purpose: Protected test-only handoff for private proposed game-role changes; the builder owns the combined implementation PR.

registration.integration: Keep the two-line child-module registration when incorporating the protected file. This existing shared registration file is not frozen against unrelated additions.

commands.runtime: TWO_TEST_DATABASE_URL=postgres://agent_test:@agent-testdb:5432/two_bot_test_local python3 scripts/cargo_cache.py run -- test -p two-bot --bin two-bot onboarding_tests::game_role_preview_acceptance:: -- --nocapture --test-threads=1
commands.existingPolicyControls: python3 scripts/cargo_cache.py run -- test -p two-bot-core --test onboarding_unknown_only_picker_acceptance --test onboarding_effects -- --nocapture

database.guard: two_bot_testsupport::TestDatabase with the cutover migration chain, isolated database per test and explicit teardown on panic
database.missingEnvironment: Outside GitHub Actions an absent TWO_TEST_DATABASE_URL prints SKIP and verifies no behavior. In GitHub Actions a missing variable fails. A configured admission/connection/migration error fails, never skips. Only a run with the guarded disposable database counts as behavioral evidence.
database.ciRoute: check.yml rust tests workspace lib/bins supplies TWO_TEST_DATABASE_URL; the existing onboarding_ ignored-runtime selector also discovers these non-ignored tests.
database.writeObserver: BEFORE STATEMENT triggers on every public fixture table advance a non-transactional sequence for INSERT/UPDATE/DELETE/TRUNCATE. A positive control detects rolled-back zero-row DML. REST recorder independently rejects any mutation except one private ACK and response edit. SQL receipts additionally reject DML.

expectedBaseline.reason: The ordinary reopened games menu has no separate self-only Preview entry. Each preview scenario must first prove this entry exists, then exercise its dispatched choices and no-effect oracles.
expectedBaseline.observedResults: Recorded separately in the immutable-head handoff document. These expected counts are not a claim that tests compiled or ran.

contract.entry: Discover one Preview-labelled text select in /reopen games, or one Preview-labelled button opening a separate text select. IDs are discovered from responses, not prescribed. Existing ordinary game selection remains available and preselected.
contract.choices: Only stable current game-menu keys, never arbitrary role IDs or hidden platform choices. Zero minimum supports a deliberately empty proposed answer. Unknown-only, mixed-invalid, forged, duplicate and oversized input never mutates; malformed input has private recovery guidance.
contract.projection: Preview — roles not changed; Additions / Removals / Unchanged sections derived from fresh member roles and current role availability. Already-held selected roles are unchanged, not additions. No applied-choice success copy.
contract.privacy: One ephemeral defer before HTTP reads; exactly one mention-suppressed private completion, at most 2000 characters, no reflected mentions, role mutations, public sends or database writes (including rollback-only attempts).
contract.safety: Re-read roles after opening; recognize member 404/403/503, wrong identity, malformed role evidence, roles-read 403, deleted catalog role, managed role, role above bot and missing Manage Roles. Foreign guild/bot/memberless interactions are silent. Unconfirmed ACK is not retried and never evaluates choices.
contract.laterApply: A separate ordinary operation re-reads current roles rather than applying the preview's stale delta. The valid apply control still writes the known subset of mixed known/stale input and records one real choice.

remainingBuilderVerification: Make all protected runtime assertions GREEN; preserve the existing core unknown-only and independent-choice controls.
Review that the preview reuses pure role-choice policy rather than mutating process_selection or the empty-effect dry-run result; this is not asserted by source-text matching.
Update and verify discoverable help, command definitions and generated reference documentation. This test-only handoff changes none of them.

Verify gateway-worker integration and same-head CI/review on the combined implementation. The fixture exercises actual onboarding ingress eligibility, ACK and worker handling, not the entire durable gateway queue.
No live Discord, deployment, production activation, new role authority or migration is authorized by these tests.
handoff: Consume the exact immutable head named in the handoff document. Never edit protected files; return corrections to the test author. Do not merge a deliberately RED test-only PR.
